effects.description: [On Play] You may place 1 card from your hand at the bottom of your deck: Draw 1 card.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
steps: (Optional) Choose 1 card from your hand and place it at the bottom of your deck
If you placed a card, draw 1 card from your deck
notes: You can choose not to use this effect when this Character is played
You only draw a card if you placed one at the bottom of your deck
